title: oscore port: add notification-replay rejection test (would have caught ythw)
description: Found by 3x codereview of the rust-oscore observe port (9liz unblock work). observe_notifications_share_request_piv_and_require_fresh_piv (/home/mark/crates/oscore/src/lib.rs, ~2483-2556) pins fresh-PIV requirement, request-PIV sharing, and ordinary one-shot consumption, but never REPLAYS a committed notification - under project-LICHEN-worker6-ythw the replay is accepted, so that assertion is the single most valuable missing pin. Add it AFTER the ythw fix lands (it would fail today): begin+commit the first notification, re-present the same (option, ciphertext) to begin_unprotect_observe_response, assert Err(Replay).
